decisions.reason: The accelerator program for green startups sits outside the core machinery business and could be cut for resources, but it is cheap to keep and supports the firm's ecosystem and partnerships.

The bio-based CO2-negative bitumen binder is an R&D-driven diversification with an uncertain market, yet it has its own page and fits the firm's circular-economy narrative, so it is likely to be kept for now.
The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the core business, backed by the ERMAFA partnership, and serves a clear regulated market.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant is a direct extension of the core WASTX modular recycling line and fits the decentralized strategy.
